versions.content: If ComM_EcuM_PNCWakeUpIndication(<PNC>) (see SWS_ComM_91001 ) is called in sub - state COMM_NO_COM_NO_PENDING_REQUEST and configuration parameters ComMSynchronousWakeUp=TRUE ( ECUC_ComM_00695 ) and ComMPncSupport=TRUE (see ECUC_ComM_00839 ), the ComM module shall switch all ComM channel state machines (resp. channels) to sub - state COMM_NO_COM_REQUEST_PENDING .

If ComM_EcuM_PNCWakeUpIndication(<PNC>) (see SWS_ComM_91001 ) is called in sub - state COMM_NO_COM_NO_PENDING_REQUEST and configuration parameters ComMSynchronousWakeUp=TRUE ( ECUC_ComM_00695 ) and ComMPncSupport=TRUE (see ECUC_ComM_00839 ), the ComM module shall switch all ComM channel state machines (resp. channels) to sub - state COMM_NO_COM_REQUEST_PENDING .

If ComM_EcuM_PNCWakeUpIndication(<PNC>) (see SWS_ComM_91001 ) is called in sub - state COMM_NO_COM_NO_PENDING_REQUEST and configuration parameters ComMSynchronousWakeUp is set to TRUE ( see ECUC_ComM_00695 ) and ComMPncSupport is set to TRUE (see ECUC_ComM_00839 ), the ComM module shall switch all ComM channel state machines (resp. channels) to sub - state COMM_NO_COM_REQUEST_PEN DING .

If ComM_EcuM_PNCWakeUpIndication(<PNC>) (see SWS_ComM_91001 ) is called in sub - state COMM_NO_COM_NO_PENDING_REQUEST and configuration parameters ComMSynchronousWakeUp is set to TRUE ( see ECUC_ComM_00695 ) and ComMPncSupport is set to TRUE (see ECUC_ComM_00839 ), the ComM module shall switch all ComM channel state machines (resp. channels) to sub - state COMM_NO_COM_REQUEST_PEN DING .
